run_coverage_training: run the TrainCoverage class to train a model with confidence set prediction and conformal calibration
compute_coverage_loss: compute the coverage loss and size loss for confidence sets using compute_loss_and_error method
select_calibration_method: select a conformal prediction calibration function like threshold or APS using select_calibrate method
select_smooth_predict: select a smooth confidence set prediction function using select_smooth_predict with threshold or APS methods
calibrate_tau: calibrate the tau threshold parameter for fine-tuning using the calibrate method with validation data
